settings.description: The user's settings (the defaults when never saved).

memcan_configured.description: MemCan is configured on this server.

memcan_projects.description: Effective MemCan projects: the repositories' short names plus the extras, deduplicated.

unreachable.description: Repositories and owners of these settings the GitHub token could not see at the latest refresh.

DashboardSettings.description: Per-user dashboard settings (body of `PUT /api/v1/settings/dashboard`); validated by the server (plan §F.6).

linked_logins.description: Other GitHub logins of the user, scanned with the own login.

repositories.description: Repositories with their rules, one row each.

enumerate_owners.description: Owners listed when GitHub search refuses a scanned login.

lookback_days.description: Days an issue counts as new (1–30).

ready_label.description: Label that marks a pull request ready for a human.

skip_authors.description:
Excluded authors: every pull request and issue they author is left out of the dashboard. Being listed
does not make a login a bot.

known_bots.description: Logins treated as bots besides GitHub's `Bot` accounts and `[bot]` logins: never a waiting human.

memcan_extra_projects.description: MemCan projects read besides the repositories' short names.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone; null until the browser sends one.

slack_names.description: GitHub logins with the Slack name "Copy for Slack" writes instead of `@login` (at most 100 rows).

alias.description: Display alias prefix (`[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{0,11}`); null = the bare repository name.

ownership_policy.description: File naming the owned paths; null = no ownership policy.

branch_patterns.description: Release and long-lived branch patterns; empty = the built-ins.

ignored_checks.description:
Checks and statuses that never make CI red or pending (whole name, case-insensitive, `*` any text); empty =
the built-ins.

PolicyRef.description: An ownership policy file (JSON format of `stale_prs_are_bad`).

SlackName.description: One row of the Slack names table: a GitHub login and the text copied for it.

login.description: GitHub login (case-insensitive, unique in the table).

slack.description:
Text written instead of `@login`, as typed (1–80 characters, no control characters), e.g.
`@jan.kowalski` or `<@U01ABC>`.
